vulnerabilities.title: OpenSSH regreSSHion Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerabilities.description: Signal handler race condition in OpenSSH server allowing unauthenticated RCE on glibc-based Linux systems.
vulnerabilities.remediationGuidance: Upgrade OpenSSH package to version >= 9.8p1 or apply vendor backported patch.

vulnerabilities.title: HTTP/2 Rapid Reset Denial of Service (Stream Reset Flood)
vulnerabilities.description: Flaw in HTTP/2 protocol stream handling allowing resource exhaustion via continuous stream resets.
vulnerabilities.remediationGuidance: Configure keepalive_requests and limit concurrent stream limits in reverse proxy.
